meta_description:
vikram_official on September 30, 2026: "We’re ready to spend lakhs on hospital bills, but hesitate to spend on our health, nutrition, and quality food.

Invest in your health today, or you may end up paying for your illness tomorrow.

🥗 Eat better.
🏋🏻‍♂️ Move more.
😴 Sleep well.
❤️ Take care of your health.

Your health is not an expense. It’s your biggest investment.".
